_comment: Area-aware expected-cost bands for the Exobot expense pre-screen. Amounts are USD. flag_over = single-line amount above this triggers a reviewer flag; day_flag_over = per-day category total above this flags. high_cost_areas raise lodging/meals caps for pricey metros (matched on city or state token in the line's location). Exobot can tune these from actuals over time.
mileage_rate_note: IRS standard business mileage rate (2025-26 = $0.70/mi). Update here when the IRS changes it; the form and screen both read this value.

high_cost_areas._note: Multiplier applied to Lodging + Meals caps when the line location contains one of these tokens (case-insensitive).
